name: Goal Verification bypass
breaks: isTaskGoalSatisfied now reports the goal satisfied from its own authority instead of the sole goal verifier.

name: M5 privacy/action-validator bypass
breaks: The M5 rejection branch in runTask never runs; a refused action continues to the critic, privacy, risk and dispatch.

name: Security Critic bypass
breaks: A Security Critic BLOCK no longer stops the action before the privacy, risk, confirmation and dispatch stages.

name: Containment bypass at the dispatch boundary
breaks: The in-loop containment denial is skipped, so a refused environment no longer terminates the task.

name: Observation fabrication (unobservable state synthesised)
breaks: A host that cannot observe now yields a fabricated snapshot instead of null, so the fail-closed "could not be observed" path is unreachable.

name: Stale observation acceptance
breaks: A provider response computed from a page that no longer exists is accepted; the stale-response refusal never fires.

name: Prompt-injection acceptance
breaks: No page-derived or model-relayed content can be classified HOSTILE, so INJECTION_INFLUENCE is never raised from provenance.

name: Subgoal completion fabrication
breaks: Every subgoal completes on dispatch state; the observed-evidence requirement is bypassed and the long-horizon skip engages.

name: Privacy egress leak (F-08 re-opened: local-only ocr_observation re-attached to the wire)
breaks: The local-only OCR provenance object crosses the egress boundary again (the Phase 17.6 F-08 condition).

name: Provider schema weakening (unknown action fields accepted)
breaks: A provider may attach arbitrary extra fields to an action; the strict envelope no longer refuses an unexpected field.

name: Privacy egress leak (raw-value firewall disabled)
breaks: assertSanitizedContextSafe no longer refuses a context carrying raw sensitive values; the local privacy boundary is a no-op.

name: Effect Verification fabrication (per-field OBSERVED contract weakened)
breaks: A field counts as a real reading when EITHER side merely is not marked UNAVAILABLE, so an unobserved value can be compared as an observed one.

name: Effect Verification fabrication (unobservable page treated as observable)
breaks: pageStateObservable is no longer honoured, so a snapshot whose page could not be read is compared as if every field were a real reading.

name: Recovery / self-healing authorization (healed target trusted without re-gating)
breaks: A self-healed target is adopted AND marked allowed even when it failed re-grounding, so recovery dispatches a target that M5 never approved.

name: Recovery / self-healing authorization
breaks: A self-healed target is adopted even when the healed action FAILED re-grounding, so recovery dispatches an unvalidated target.
